body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite sheet for fictional Thistle190, an original logo-free small 1990 French three-door hot hatch reimagined in salvage year2994. Reference image is ONLY for painted texture, transparent shell structure and eight-view layout, NOT its sports coupe shape. New car must be short upright boxy front-engine hatchback, tall square rear hatch, short bonnet, squared wheel arches, broad side windows, three doors. Muted dusty plum paint, faded red thin side stripe, black plastic bumper/arch trim, small welded patches, chipped paint and light rust. Distinct fictional rectangular headlights and simple divided rear lights, no badges, logos, text. Same consistent car in all eight views, orthographic low eye-level, no perspective dramatic tilt. Wide3:1 image, four equally spaced columns x two rows. Top row: front straight; front three-quarter with nose LEFT; full side nose LEFT; rear three-quarter with nose RIGHT. Bottom row: rear straight; rear three-quarter with nose LEFT; full side nose RIGHT; front three-quarter with nose RIGHT. Match reference spacing with complete uncropped bodies. Critically shell only: NO tires, wheels, hubs, axles or brake discs. Wheel openings must be actual empty transparent semicircular cutouts open at bottom, not black painted circles. Transparent background everywhere outside car shell, no shadows or ground. Dark windows, consistent details across views. Hand-painted gritty semi-realistic game art, clean readable silhouettes.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production cockpit dashboard overlay for original fictional Thistle190, a 1990 French small boxy three-door hot hatch rebuilt in salvage year2994. Input reference provides overlay structure/painted texture only, not its sports car design. Create a DIFFERENT simple utilitarian upright 1990 hatchback dashboard: charcoal cracked plastic, faded plum-painted metal fascia, narrow faded red trim, square vents, simple three rotary climate controls centrally, shallow glovebox on right, a few restrained riveted repair patches. Left-hand drive. Wide 2.5:1 canvas. Front-facing driver's view, dashboard fills lower half from edge to edge, narrow A-pillars only far edges. Upper half windshield opening must be genuinely transparent, not black background. IMPORTANT blank opaque pure-black instrument binnacle on LEFT, a large clean rounded rectangular recess from approximately x220 to840,y510 to750 in 1983x793 reference-sized composition. It must have no dials, numbers, markings or texture inside so runtime gauges can be composited. Binnacle hood top around y500, preserve room above for road. No steering wheel, no steering column obscuring recess, no hands, no seats, no scenery, no text, no logos, no extra screens. Same gritty semi-realistic hand-painted game style and muted dusty plum palette as body. Preserve actual transparency above dash and outside pillars. Black binnacle stays OPAQUE.
